name: Axiom Systems Neural Interface Diagnostic Tool NIDT-3
product_name: Axiom Systems Neural Interface Diagnostic Tool NIDT-3
description: A handheld diagnostic device that assesses the health and integrity of a neural interface without requiring medical facility access. The NIDT-3 connects to the interface's external diagnostic port and performs a comprehensive assessment — checking processor function, memory integrity, connection quality with neural tissue, firmware version, and security status. The tool identifies hardware faults, firmware corruption, unauthorized modifications, and potential security compromises. Axiom designed it for field technicians maintaining neural interfaces in environments far from clinical facilities.

specifications.info: memory; neural connection; firmware; security; firmware corruption; unauthorized mods; unauthorized access detection
specifications.output: Detailed report to linked device or neural interface

story_hooks: An NIDT-3 scan revealed that a patient's neural interface had been modified with firmware not matching any known version — the modification was installed without the patient's knowledge and its function is unclear.

NIDT-3 tools have been modified to inject diagnostic payloads rather than just reading them — the diagnostic connection has been weaponized to compromise the neural interface during what appears to be a routine checkup.
